'''Barab''' was the dim [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Barab system/Legends|Barab system]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by three [[Planet/Legends|planets]]&mdash;[[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], [[Barab II]], and [[Barab III]].<ref name="GatORW" />
